evidence.reason: `provider_cooldowns()` only parses the file with `json.loads` and performs no validation of the stored timestamp values. `dispatch_paused()` then compares `state.get(provider, '') <= utc()`, so a syntactically valid but semantically corrupt entry such as `{"zai":""}` is treated as an expired cooldown and permits dispatch. That contradicts the stated fail-closed intent at line 155 ("Corrupt state must not silently spend against a known exhausted provider") and can allow spending against an exhausted provider without operator recovery.
